title: Concept: Object storage bucket listing disclosed in a response
description: The S3 ListBucketResult document enumerates object keys with sizes and timestamps. Object keys routinely encode environment, date and owner, so a public listing turns an unpredictable key space into a downloadable inventory.
applicability: Responses served from an S3 bucket configured for public listing.
risk: Every object key in the bucket is readable; MEDIUM severity because the listing itself may expose sensitive names and the objects may be public too.
